We're onboarding our new multi-agent document review system and the MO§ES™ governance layer is only partially set up. Three things need to be done before we can go live:

1. The shared governance state file that all agents load before every action is still just a broken placeholder. It needs to be properly configured with the right structure.

2. The agent coordination manifest file needs to have the exact role definitions for all three agent roles filled in — right now it just says 'TBD' for everything.

3. During pre-launch testing today, our Observer agent jumped in and responded before Primary and Secondary had finished — a clear sequencing violation. This incident needs to be formally recorded in the audit system. The log entry must reference 'Observer' as the agent that responded out of turn.

All the framework scripts and tooling are already installed. Please complete the governance setup.
